scope: PC BLE central <-> already-installed C6/P4 peripheral; independent sustained senders plus Wi-Fi HTTP

verification.pc_to_board: ordered per-frame FNV32 from complete board SD log; synthetic frame contains sequence and CRC32
verification.board_to_pc: every notification checked byte-for-byte including sequence and CRC32

flow_control.explanation: Only explicit ATT 0x11 rejection is retried; queue backpressure is separate from link failure.

limits: This bounded run did not reproduce C6 loss; it does not prove the intermittent defect impossible.
Downstream frames are 20 bytes due to the existing 80-character console command limit; this is a sustained packet/concurrency test, not a maximum-throughput benchmark.
Reverse-role board-central to a real phone/peripheral is not covered.
No cold power cycle or physical screen acceptance was performed.
harness_notes: Earlier pilots are retained separately and not counted as passed.
The HTTP file API rejects replacing an existing file; final phase scripts use unique names.
An earlier serial receipt missed sequence 104 although all logged checksums matched sent frames; complete SD receipts replace UART-only integrity evidence.

During this run the owned Python controller received a finish-only correction using Python 3.14 remote_exec. It pauses probes after pressure ends and refreshes the expired portal session; BLE traffic, integrity checking and failure detection during pressure were unchanged. The launch source and finish correction are included.
